thread:
alex: Kicking off rollout v2.6.4 to USW2 (canary 10%). Seeing a small p95 jitter on embeddings route.
jamie: Got the deploybot alert too. How bad is "small"? can you paste the metric?
alex: p95 increased from 110ms -> 125ms over last 3m, error rate flat. deploybot flagged quality signal but not breaching auto-rollback threshold.
deploybot: ALERT: canary p95 +13% over baseline. Auto-rollback criteria: >=20% p95 increase OR >=1.5% error rate sustained 5m. Current: p95 +13% (3m), errors 0.12%.
sara: We should decide ASAP — release notes still missing the embeddings caveat. Customers might hit slightly different latency.
ops-oncall: If deploybot won't auto-roll, we can either let it continue (watch) or pin and hold. What's the risk tolerance for this change window?
alex: My call is to hold the canary at 10% for 10m to see if it stabilizes. If it crosses auto thresholds, let auto-rollback run. If not, proceed to 50% after release notes update.
jamie: +1 to hold. Also recommend disabling scheduled traffic increase until release notes pushed. I can push a tiny docs patch: `git checkout -b release/2.6.4-notes && echo "Embeddings: minor latency variance on canary" >> CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "docs: note embeddings latency" && git push`.
sara: Thanks — if you push, I'll send the customer comms blurb. We should also record the decision in the release thread.
ops-oncall: Note: manual-rollback authority assigned to oncall if error >0.5% or p95 >20% per the SLO playbook. We'll escalate if thresholds hit.
deploybot: ACTION: canary hold applied by alex. Traffic frozen at 10%. Auto-rollback remains enabled.
jamie: docs patch pushed, PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/312 — please review rapido.
alex: PR reviewed and merged. Release notes updated.
sara: Customer comms drafted and scheduled for immediate send once we decide to continue rollout.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for next 8 minutes. If p95 drops <10% above baseline -> proceed to 50% at +2m. If p95 >=20% or errors >=0.5% -> execute rollback to 2.6.3.
alex: Acknowledged. If we need to rollback, use `/deploy rollback --to 2.6.3 --region=usw2` and ping #customer-notify for the comms.
deploybot: NOTE: rollback command will attempt graceful drain; estimate ~3-4m to fully revert traffic for canary slice.
jamie: thumbs: :thumbsup:
sara: I'll be standing by to hit send on comms and update the incident tracker with the final decision.
ops-oncall: current metrics: p95 +9% (5m avg), errors 0.08% — continuing hold.
alex: OK, proceeding to ramp to 50% in 2m per the plan unless ops calls rollback.
ops-oncall: no rollback. Proceeding. I'll close the hold and monitor during the next ramp window."
